QuestInfo.name: The Girl and the Maple Tree
QuestInfo.0: Speak with Sugar at Maple Tree Hill.
QuestInfo.1: Sugar wants you to bring her some water. Borrow a bucket from #bLucas#k, then get some water from #bSplit Road of Destiny#k.
QuestInfo.2: You put out the fire. The Maple Tree is safe.
